_how: Copy to manual.json. Keys are map ids (the Pet Map's 'To add' box lists the ones missing). Points are [x, y] pixels on "image", or, without one, on plugins/plus-souls/maps/<id in lower case>.webp (2048 across). Monsters and Kibelisks go by English name. Points left at [0, 0] are skipped. Then run: python3 -I tools/citizen-map/build_map.py --offline
